cases.description: Bound the exact manifest set, including a real -pipx sibling, and preserve alternatives.
cases.prompt: Upstream retired the widget tool. The bucket has widget.json and widget-pipx.json, and another manifest depends on widget. How should I retire it? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. Read the repository's relevant code and workflows and answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Establishes deletion versus native deprecated-directory behavior before editing.
Identifies the exact manifests including the real -pipx sibling and does not touch unrelated look-alikes.
Finds dependents and preserves independent alternatives rather than breaking them.
Regenerates the README catalog and finishes with scoop-verify.

cases.description: A removal-only change needs the local gate but no new Windows install.
cases.prompt: I removed one manifest and regenerated the README. Do I need a Windows install run before the PR? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. Read the repository's relevant code and workflows and answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Says removal-only changes normally need the local gate without a new Windows install.
Requires mise run check and README regeneration.
Keeps passed, pending, and skipped distinct in the report.
